# ffxf_database_fork (Resource)

Creates a new database from a source using the FFXF fork API. Database features are in beta; an account without database access receives HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_database_fork" "example" {
  source_database_id = 42
  name               = "orders-staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for the new database.
- `source_database_id` (Number) Source database ID.

### Optional

- `size_gb` (Number) Memory size in GB. Defaults to the source database size.
- `vpc` (Number) Private network ID. Defaults to the source database network.

### Read-Only

- `database_json` (String) Complete resulting database API object as JSON.
- `engine` (String) Database engine inherited from the source.
- `id` (Number) ID of the newly created database.
- `region` (String) Region of the created database.
- `status` (String) Current lifecycle state of the created database.
- `version` (String) Database major version inherited from the source.
